name: Nakheel 6, New Cairo Apt, 2BDR
headline: The Sleek & Ritzy 2 BDR | 15 min from CAI Airpt.

description.Space:
This unique 2 bedroom apartment is perfect for families and business travelers. 

The 2 bedroom apartment includes a spacious reception area with a combined living that includes a bright outdoor balcony.  There is a fully equipped kitchen, cooking utensils and a Nespresso coffee machine. The living room is furnished with a sofa set along with a 55 inch smart TV with AirPlay built-in for further personal entertainment. There are two full bathrooms one of which is equipped with a bath tub. 
The first bedroom includes a queen size bed & along with a spacious walk in dressing room.
The second bedroom includes two single beds.  
Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 
- Free of charge street parking is available.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment. There is 1 locked unused room.
description.Interaction: Guests can text and call us anytime they need assistance. We'll be happy to address any issues right away.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is peaceful, upscale and safe. Cairo Festival City Mall - considered to be the best mall in New Cairo,  is a 2 minute drive from the apartment.
 
- Cairo International Airport is a 10 min drive.
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive
description.Transit: We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Cool apartment!

Great stay! As a traveler from the US I appreciated the plug ins accommodating standard usb for our electronics (no need for converter chargers) .

Only thing I’d wish is for actual wash cloths to shower with . They did have towels and linens but we needed actual wash clothes for bathing. (This is minor). 

However do NOT let that stop you from booking here. Airbnb was beautiful! And so affordable and worth it. VERY spacious (it was just two of us in my party traveling) It was in a great area of New Cairo with lots of food and restaurants nearby. Uber found us daily with no issues. Hosts respond VERY quick , offer recommendations and more. English speaking , so that was a major plus. Please don’t hesitate to book!

Unfortunately, my experience at this apartment was not good.

I stayed there with my family. The rest of my family slept in the master bedroom, while I slept in the second bedroom, which was the room with the problematic air conditioner.

On the first night, the air conditioner was extremely noisy, started leaking water, and then stopped producing cold air. Because the water was dripping onto the furniture and the floor underneath the air conditioner, I had to place towels there myself to absorb the water and prevent further mess.

I contacted the hosts, and they told me that someone would come the following morning by a specific time to repair it. I waited for them, but nobody showed up within the agreed time.

Later, they sent me videos saying that someone had eventually come after the scheduled time and that the air conditioner was working properly. However, when I returned to the apartment, I found that it was still not working correctly and was not producing cold air.

On the second night, it started making loud noises again. After a while, the noise stopped, but the air conditioner also stopped working. I sent the hosts more videos showing the problem, but no effective repair was carried out during my stay. As I was sleeping in that bedroom, I was unable to sleep at all on either of the two nights.

There was also only one remote control for the air conditioners in both bedrooms — the master bedroom, where the rest of my family was sleeping, and the second bedroom where I was sleeping. I mentioned this to the hosts as well, but a second remote control was never provided. In any case, this would not have solved the main problem, since the air conditioner in my bedroom was not functioning properly.

The cleanliness and general condition of the apartment were also disappointing. The floor was so dirty that if you walked around the apartment barefoot, your feet would quickly turn black. The shower area had also not been properly cleaned.
